faq.d: Storage, cable, AI, GDPR, monitoring — the 8 questions dispatch hears daily.
faq.q1: How much storage do I need for 30 days of 4K?
faq.a1: Rule of thumb: 4× 4K cams at 8 Mbps + 40% motion ≈ 2 TB for 30 days.
faq.q2: How far can PoE cameras run from the NVR?
faq.a2: 90 m on solid copper Cat6, surge-protected both ends.
faq.q3: Will AI detection stop false alarms from trees and cats?
faq.a3: Yes — when tuned. Tight polygons + min-object size cut events ~92%.
faq.q4: Is CCTV GDPR-compliant? Do I need signs?
faq.a4: Yes, signs are mandatory where cameras cover shared/public areas.
faq.q5: What does 24/7 monitoring cost, and what happens on alarm?
faq.a5: From $49/mo. Operator reviews in <60 s, audio challenge, then escalation.
faq.q6: What warranty and SLA do I get?
faq.a6: 3-year warranty. Retail/Site: 8 h SLA with loan cameras.
faq.q7: Can I view cameras on my phone and in the office?
faq.a7: Both. Phone app + TV/PC view included in every pack.
faq.q8: How fast is the quote? Do you reuse existing cable?
faq.a8: Fixed quote in 24 h. We reuse healthy copper after a cable test.
